title: Danfoss VLT: startup settings and bypass terminals
equipment: Danfoss VLT HVAC drive (from the Danfoss startup cheat sheet; not a Danfoss manual)

options.label: Drive on a bypass will not start
Wrong motor direction or speed range

r_bypass.cause: For drives with bypass, the run permissive, start command and external interlock each land on specific terminals.
fix: Terminal block X55 pins 1 and 2: run permissive (drive terminal 19).
X55 pins 3 and 4: start command (drive terminal 18).
X55 pins 5 and 6: external interlock/safety (drive terminal 27).
Have the tech check each of the three circuits is in the correct state. Never jumper the interlock to force a start.

r_params.cause: The cheat sheet lists the parameters to set after entering motor data; any parameter not listed is left as it is.
fix: Quick Menu > Quick Setup: enter motor info, then 3-41 ramp up 10 s for pumps (60 s fans), 3-42 ramp down 10 s pumps (60 s fans), 4-12 motor speed low 18 Hz, 4-14 motor speed high 60 Hz.
Quick Menu > Function Setup > Open Loop > Analog Reference: 3-02 minimum reference 0 Hz, 3-03 maximum reference 60 Hz, 6-14 terminal 53 low 0.000, 6-15 terminal 53 high 60.000.
Main Menu 1 Load and Motor: 1-03 variable torque, 1-29 AMA enable complete AMA, 1-73 flying start disabled for pumps and enabled for fans.
Main Menu 4: 4-10 motor speed direction clockwise only for pumps, both directions for fans.
Main Menu 15: 15-43 software version for the paperwork.
These are the cheat sheet values; confirm against the project requirements and record old and new values for every change.

r_dir.cause: Direction and speed limits are set by parameters 4-10, 4-12 and 4-14.
fix: 4-10 should be clockwise only for pumps and both directions for fans.
Speed range on the cheat sheet: 18 Hz low (4-12) to 60 Hz high (4-14).
Confirm the project requirement before changing anything and record old and new values.
